about: Notes about the people in your life: what you talked about, what's going on with them, birthdays, gift ideas. Say "note about Sam: …".

table.name: People
table.description: Notes about the people in your life: what you talked about, what is going on with them, birthdays, gift ideas.
conventions: One row per person. A note about someone already here is appended to their Notes, never a new row. Match the name as they said it, allowing for nicknames and speech-to-text mangling; when two people could match, ask rather than guess.
Each appended note starts with the recording's date, then what they said in their words, tightened: '2026-11-06: Sam started the new job at the clinic, loves it'.
Birthday is a date; when no year is said, use the year 2000. Set it only when they say it.
Gift ideas go one per line in Gift Ideas. When adding to a person who already has some, include the existing ones: an update replaces the field wholesale.
One recording can be about several people: 'Note about Sam and Alex: they're moving to Denver' appends to both.
